verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a dedicated Prompt Caching capability that works automatically on supported requests, with no cache breakpoints or code changes needed. The rate-limit docs say cached tokens don't count toward the uncached TPM limit, so higher cache hit rates let the same limit serve far more total tokens. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of latency/TTFT reduction or a per-token cost discount for cached tokens, the list of supported models and cache-lifetime details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
